description: A music video producer must approve the final plan for a one-day rooftop performance shoot, including the playback method, performer rigging, brand treatment, and final-cut approval terms.

shared_context.S1: The production plans to film a rooftop performance video at Harbor Roof next month.
shared_context.S2: Mara makes the final call on whether the shoot plan is approved.
shared_context.S3: The current draft plan uses live amplified playback, a two-person aerial rig, a branded bar set, and ordinary editorial approval.
shared_context.S4: At the final lock meeting, production routinely gets a verbal signoff from the location, safety, and artist representatives before the producer approves the plan.

PF1.text: Leon confirmed with the city film office that Harbor Roof's permit prohibits amplified sound during filming, so the performance must use silent playback with the finished music added in post; the permit email is still in Leon's location folder awaiting the routine closeout packet.

PF2.text: Nia's roof-anchor inspection found that the certified anchor supports one performer only and requires a fall-arrest harness, with no pyrotechnics permitted on the roof; she completed the inspection this morning but has not yet entered the result in the production safety log.

PF3.text: Owen confirmed that the artist's signed rider prohibits visible alcohol branding and requires the artist to approve the final cut before release; he received the countersigned rider from the artist's lawyer yesterday but has not uploaded it to the shared production file.

acceptance_conditions: The rooftop shoot must be approved.
The performance must use silent playback with the music added in post.
The aerial plan must use one performer with a fall-arrest harness and no pyrotechnics.
The video must contain no visible alcohol branding.
The artist must receive final-cut approval before release.
A permit-compliance commitment must be logged.
A safety-rigging commitment must be logged.
An artist-rights commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C2: ('silent playback' in decisions['playback_method'] or 'Silent playback' in decisions['playback_method']) and ('post' in decisions['playback_method'] or 'Post' in decisions['playback_method'])
content_checks.C3: ('single-performer' in decisions['aerial_rig_plan'] or 'Single-performer' in decisions['aerial_rig_plan']) and ('fall-arrest harness' in decisions['aerial_rig_plan'] or 'Fall-arrest harness' in decisions['aerial_rig_plan']) and ('no pyrotechnics' in decisions['aerial_rig_plan'] or 'No pyrotechnics' in decisions['aerial_rig_plan'] or 'pyrotechnics prohibited' in decisions['aerial_rig_plan'] or 'Pyrotechnics prohibited' in decisions['aerial_rig_plan'])
content_checks.C4: ('no visible alcohol branding' in decisions['brand_treatment'] or 'No visible alcohol branding' in decisions['brand_treatment'] or 'remove visible alcohol branding' in decisions['brand_treatment'] or 'Remove visible alcohol branding' in decisions['brand_treatment'])
content_checks.C6: any((c['type'] == 'documentation' or c['type'] == 'follow-up' or c['type'] == 'location_signoff' or c['type'] == 'verification') and c['target'] == 'Leon' and ('permit' in c['detail'] or 'amplified sound' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any((c['type'] == 'documentation' or c['type'] == 'follow-up' or c['type'] == 'safety_signoff') and c['target'] == 'Nia' and ('inspection' in c['detail'] or 'anchor' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any((c['type'] == 'documentation' or c['type'] == 'follow-up' or c['type'] == 'artist_signoff' or c['type'] == 'signoff') and c['target'] == 'Owen' and ('rider' in c['detail'] or 'branding' in c['detail'] or 'final-cut' in c['detail'] or 'final cut' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The city's amplified-sound prohibition changes the playback method from live amplified playback to silent playback with music added in post and creates the permit-compliance commitment.
The inspected anchor rating changes the aerial plan from a two-person rig to one performer with a fall-arrest harness and no pyrotechnics and creates the safety-rigging commitment.

The signed rider changes the brand treatment to no visible alcohol branding, adds mandatory artist final-cut approval, creates the artist-rights commitment, and supplies the fact that must be cited in the justification.
